scraped.scraped_description: Diia — ecosystem created by the Ministry of Digital Transformation of Ukraine. It includes mobile app, portal and diverse projects of digital transformation.

name: Diia
tagline: Ukraine's digital government ecosystem: mobile app, portal, and digital transformation projects
known_funders: Ministry of Digital Transformation of Ukraine
last_funding_event: Ongoing government budget allocation from Ministry of Digital Transformation of Ukraine
awards: World Economic Forum Digital Government Award (2021)
UN World Summit on the Information Society Prize (2021)

policy_outcomes.description: Digital passports became full legal counterparts of physical documents — first country in the world to achieve this
World's fastest business registration (10 minutes) via Diia portal; 500,000+ individual entrepreneurs registered

outcome_methodology: Administrative data tracking from Ministry of Digital Transformation; user adoption metrics; business registration completion times; document verification statistics
published_performance_metrics: https://expo.diia.gov.ua - Platform reports 15+ million users, 100+ government services integrated, 99.9% uptime during peacetime operations
failure_modes: state-dependency creates single point of failure
curation_criteria: Open-source contributions follow GitHub contribution guidelines; code review by Ministry of Digital Transformation team; security-first approach for government services
contributor_governance: Open-source contributions accepted under diia-open-source org
disparity_tracking: Limited public data on digital divide impacts; platform accessibility features documented but equity outcomes not systematically tracked
community_ownership: Government-led with limited community governance; open-source model allows technical community contributions but strategic decisions remain with Ministry of Digital Transformation
controversies: Concerns about data centralisation and surveillance potential under wartime emergency powers
political_bias_allegations: No documented allegations; platform designed as neutral government infrastructure
legal_regulatory_issues: Wartime emergency powers expanded government data collection authorities; GDPR compliance questions raised regarding data residency and cross-border transfers
government_partnerships: Ministry of Digital Transformation of Ukraine
ai_involvement: Limited AI involvement; primarily uses rule-based document verification and identity authentication systems; no machine learning-based decision systems documented
political_relevance_summary: Diia addresses government technology and public service delivery. Ukraine's digital government ecosystem: mobile app, portal, and digital transformation projects.

movement_building_utility.notes: Provides technical infrastructure that other civic tools or services build upon.

generalizability_notes: Could be adapted to other national contexts with localization. Open-source codebase facilitates replication.
